meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 8 — Fiscal (state budget, public debt) and education / human capital densification.

candidates.title: State budget revenue and expenditure statistics
candidates.description: Official state budget execution reports covering revenue collection, expenditure and overall fiscal balance. Provides the primary fiscal-flow series for the central and local budgets.

candidates.title: State budget deficit statistics
candidates.description: Official deficit figures for the state budget (central and local components) as a share of GDP and in absolute terms. Closely monitored against National Assembly targets.
candidates.notes: Deficit densification of the fiscal cluster.

candidates.title: Public debt and government debt statistics
candidates.description: Official public debt, government debt and external debt ratios relative to GDP, together with related debt-service indicators. Maintained well below statutory ceilings in recent years (public debt typically mid-30s % of GDP).

candidates.title: Education enrolment and completion statistics
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / Ministry of Education and Training
candidates.description: Net and gross enrolment rates and completion rates by education level (primary, lower secondary, upper secondary). Vietnam has achieved near-universal primary enrolment and high lower-secondary coverage.
candidates.notes: Core education access and progression node.

candidates.title: Literacy and educational attainment of the population
candidates.description: Literacy rates and distribution of the population by highest educational attainment and technical qualifications. Average years of schooling and the share of the adult population with upper-secondary or higher education form key human-capital stock indicators.

candidates.title: Higher education and technical qualifications statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on tertiary education and the share of the population holding technical or university-level qualifications. Complements basic enrolment and literacy series.
candidates.notes: Tertiary / skills densification of the human-capital cluster.

candidates.title: Vietnam fiscal–education densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from MOF, GSO and MOET sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding state budget revenue and expenditure, budget deficit, public debt, education enrolment and completion, literacy and educational attainment, and higher-education/technical qualifications into a coherent fiscal and human-capital layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

candidates.notes: Integrating node for the fiscal and education densification pass.
